content.text: Build and launch a complete Streamlit MVP for MemoryWeaver — an AI-powered multi-book family and friendship chronicle. Requirements: Groq API (llama-3.3-70b-versatile), structured JSON output with chapter_title, formatted_story, extracted_tags. Multi-Book Workspaces: Family Heritage Vault and Friends Trip Anthology. Integrate DevRelay session logging so the build can be published to DEV.

Read devrelay-community-wisdom skill. Searched DEV community for Streamlit + Groq best practices. Consensus: use response_format={'type': 'json_object'} directly on Groq SDK, wrap in try/except for JSONDecodeError, use st.session_state for persistence.

content.name: search_web
content.input: Streamlit Groq API LLM app best practices JSON response structured output
content.output: Best practice: schema-first with response_format JSON object, temperature=0.7, always wrap in try/except, use st.session_state to persist structured objects across reruns.
